title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1973-11-11
lineage: Nakamichi CR-7A > Tascam DA-3000 @ 24 bit 96 kHz
source: dead center 10 rows back with a Sony ECM-22P mic (mono)> Sony TC-55 > BASF C90 master cassettes

ai_review.summary: Historic 1973 field recording praised for its depth and rarity despite the limits of early‑stage cassette equipment
ai_review.review: The reviewer lauds this rare field capture as a valuable document of the Dead’s early‑70s sound, noting the richness that comes from a direct soundboard patch recorded close to the PA. While acknowledging the mono TC‑55 cassette's fidelity constraints and some sand damage, they celebrate the effort and engineering that made the recording possible. No specific musical performance details are given.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review focused on recording history rather than musical content; the recording is praised for its historical value but has technical limitations, leading to a moderate overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mono TC‑55 cassette from 1973, limited hi‑fi fidelity, some sand damage; however, the direct soundboard patch provides surprising depth and ambience for a field recording of its era.
